entries.name: Dominion OS 1.0 for Business — Windows x64
entries.requirements: Self-contained Windows x64 Business package; no separate .NET Desktop Runtime prerequisite; Politics is excluded from the downloadable artifact
entries.description: Exact Business-only Windows candidate. Source is committed and provenance-bound; package integrity, tamper rejection, install, first launch, integrity verification, Windows registration, deterministic shutdown, uninstall, Microsoft Defender, SBOM, provenance, security notice and privacy notice have passed. Public distribution remains withheld until verified Authenticode publisher signing is provisioned and completed.

entries.name: Dominion OS 1.0 for Politics — Public Demonstration
entries.requirements: Synthetic public demonstration only; no downloadable Politics artifact is authorized
entries.description: Politics remains part of the Dominion product story, mission architecture and public-safe demonstrations. It is deliberately excluded from downloadable distribution until it receives separate certification and principal approval.

entries.name: Dominion OS 1.0 for Business — Google Cloud Deployment Family
entries.requirements: Customer-controlled Google Cloud project, identity, IAM, runtime, containers, storage, connectors, cost, security and release evidence scoped per deployment
entries.description: Google Cloud is the first cloud deployment path for the Business experience. Deployment readiness does not certify a currently live public provider runtime.

entries.name: Dominion OS 1.0 + SaaS Suite for Business — Google Cloud for Windows
entries.requirements: Common certified Windows Business payload plus provider-specific profile; exact signed package, checksum, SBOM/provenance, lifecycle acceptance, security scan, release-registry promotion and publicDownloadCertified=true required before public download
entries.description: Required Google Cloud Windows Business distribution family. Provider source exists at Fractal5-Solutions/dominion-os-1.0-gcloud. Current provider evidence: DEPLOYMENT_READY_SOURCE / RUNTIME_UNCERTIFIED. This entry is a release target, not a downloadable artifact.
